statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has a significant personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered
The service was to assess for arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The service was to optimize anticoagulation and rate control strategies
The diagnosis codes submitted are I48.91 and Z86.73
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
